Where East Meets West. Exploring the fusion of Italian and Asian cuisine Australian Italian Chef, Adam Swanson collaborates with Chefs from regions all over Asia, sharing and swapping traditional flavours and ingredients to create magical new fusion recipes.

Brand new series where the UK's most passionate cooks get a once-in-a-lifetime chance to launch their own food brand to the British public. Cooking Up a Fortune sees amateur foodies, who dream of escaping the rat race and cooking for a living, create and sell their dishes to hundreds of real diners in a purpose-built food arena. Each week the winning kitchen gets to launch their idea for a food business to paying customers in one of Europe's busiest food markets.

Grab your camera and get ready for a global backstreet tour! Each episode of this series links up with a local photographer who knows the best spots in town for great pictures, fascinating facts, and unforgettable adventures.

After listening to Bibi read them 'Jack and the Beanstalk', Sneeze has a bizarre dream where he is Jack, Hiccup is his granny and Bibi is the giant as well as a variety of other familiar fairy tale characters.

Anything and everything can happen IN OUR HOUSE. A magical and colorful house with equally quirky occupants. ALVIN loves to read and always has the answers to any problems. SEAN, the resident joker, is affable with his misadventures. The rose among the thorns, K-NA proves herself a strong independent lady who does not need to wait for a knight in shining armour. Together, they are joined by MEX and BO, the two monsters who love to have fun. Innovative segments with a deep focus and awareness are all part of the entertaining and engaging new format. IN OUR HOUSE is full of surprises and is more interactive and energetic than you have ever seen before. In an entertaining mix of song, dance, music and drama, join the wacky hosts as they introduce the LETTERS AND NUMBERS OF THE DAY and the adventures that they encounter. Follow them through the SHOCKADELIC DOOR, which will lead them to interesting and unexpected places. Look out through the WINDOW to learn and see more things than you could ever imagine. And the MAGIC BOX brings to you unexpected gifts that can only be culled by your imagination. IN OUR HOUSE opens its doors to a host of characters from the fairy tales and nursery rhymes. Learn more about these characters and you would be surprised with the new and unexpected twists that the characters reveal in the show. The BIG BAD WOLF is simply a misunderstood wolf. GOLDILOCKS visits with a bowl of porridge but got distracted by the hosts' red cherries and strawberries. LITTLE BO BEEP was lost looking for her sheep that ran away but ended up IN OUR HOUSE. And the PRINCESS WITH THE PEA is on the search for her missing pre-nuptial gifts. These and many other colourful characters will pay a visit IN OUR HOUSE for some fun and game.

Can you spell words like necessary, accommodate or even Kyrgyzstan without the help of Spell Check? Well, our Spell Casters can! This season on Spell Cast, 48 kids aged 9-11 from 30 schools around Singapore are here for the ultimate spelling challenge! They are some of the best spellers around and nothing fazes them. One of them will be crowned the Spell Cast champion at the end of 13 weeks. Who will it be?

Kristiansen took on the role of a chef in Einstein’s Tingkat, a cooking and arts show where he and a group of children, playing chefs too, would draw the dishes they wanted to cook before bringing the recipes to life.
The adventures of Tayo, a blue bus with the number 120. He is very playful and mischievous with his passengers and his friends.

After a highly unlikely turn of events, Weasy, an opportunistic weasel with a nose for burglary, finds himself sitting on a huge egg during its final moments before hatching. Two little twin ducklings come out peeping – and, naturally, they latch onto Weasy as their Pop!

Modern women with new-age beliefs. Is marriage really hell or bliss? Papa Hao is a widowed restaurant chef who single-handedly raised three daughters. Eldest daughter Meiman is a successful advertising agent who believes that women should always place career before marriage. Ironic to her extravagant lifestyle, Meiman ends up with her miserly colleague whom she bickers with incessantly from workplace to home.. Second daughter Meili is a TV producer who yearns to start a family but is always rejected by her matchmaking prospects because of her ordinary looks. When she finally chances upon her Korean Prince Charming, she finds that her younger sister too has fallen for the same guy...Youngest daughter Meide is an independent and open-minded graduate who has been spoilt by her father and sisters. While she enjoys the pursuit by her suitors, she does not equate love to marriage. Not until she meets her traditional mother-in-law-to-be and sparks start flying... Like all romantic fairy tales, will the three sisters get married and live happily ever after?

This drama is set in the Jiufen area from the 1960s to the 1970s. It tells the story of how three brothers conquered the world with their bare hands. Through the love story of the previous generation, it connects the common emotions between the two generations depicting the memories and in-depth exploration of the differences in values between them. 本剧以1960年代至1970年代的九份地区为背景，述说三个拜把兄弟如何赤手空拳打天下，藉由上一代的爱情故事串连与第二代之间共同的情感与记忆，深度探索两代之间的价值观差异。

Xu Long Bin (Romeo Tan) is a reservist officer who saved Chen Jin Bao’s (Pierre Png) life during a military exercise. Instead of being grateful, Jin Bao blames Long Bin for his damaged car. From then, the duo never see eye to eye. Lu Jun Guang (Desmond Tan) becomes their mediator and the three men eventually became friends. Jun Guang is in love with Shen Yi Xuan (Paige Chua), who cannot get over the memory of her dead boyfriend. While Bai Jin Yu (Felicia Chin), Jun Guang’s childhood friend, is always at his side through thick and thin. New recruit Yao Wei Guo (Shane Pow) dislikes Yang Xian Feng (Ricky Koh) and constantly picks on him. But Xian Feng proves himself to be a kind and compassionate buddy, and they eventually become good friends. Their friendship is tested when they fall in love with the same girl. Long Bin, Jun Guang and Jin Bao are patrolling a restricted military area when they encounter a terrorist attack. Will they be able to put their military skills to good use and stop the terrorist attack? 许龙斌（陈罗密欧）是一名战备军官，在一次的军习中搭救了陈金保（方展发）。对方不但不领情，还嫌龙斌搞砸了他的宝贝名车，两人因此冤家路窄。陆俊光（陈泂江）渐渐地帮他们解除了彼此间的芥蒂，三人最终变成了推心置腹的好友。俊光爱上了沈宜萱（蔡琦慧）并成为她的男友，但是第三者的介入造成了复杂的三角恋。然而，从小与俊光青梅竹马的白静雨（陈凤玲）却始终默默地守候在他身边。姚卫国（包勋评）起初对杨先锋（许瑞奇）感到不屑，还常常处处为难他。先锋不与他计较，给予协助与照顾，卫国因此对先锋有所改观，最后两人还成为好兄弟。但是，两人却同时爱上同一个女孩。这一天，龙斌、俊光、金保正在巡逻军事重区，正好遇到恐怖分子的攻击。受过军训的他们是否能学以致用，及时解除危机，防止一场浩劫的发生？

The three new sets of hosts of

Jean-Pierre Werner, a revered and devoted country doctor, discovers that he is suffering from an inoperable tumor. As a doctor from the city arrives to help him with his practice, Werner is troubled by the thought that he is no longer irreplaceable.

Pete is cautiously excited about reuniting with his college crew for a birthday weekend. But, one by one, his friends slowly turn against him. Is he being punished, is he paranoid, or is he part of some sick joke?

Lake Como, Italy. A cyclist is hit off the road by a jeep in the night before Christmas Eve. What happened that night? How will this accident change the destiny of the rich Bernaschi family and the Rovelli family on the edge of bankruptcy?

Lincoln Jefferson, an Iraqi War veteran, working as a school janitor tries to mend his relationship with his son after a divorce. When his son is killed by a police officer found innocent without standing trial, he takes matters into his own hands.

In the ashes of war, three strangers - a woman forced to sell her body, a starving orphan, and a broken soldier - find fragile solace together. Shadow Of Fire is a raw, haunting tale of loss, survival, and the fleeting warmth of human connection.

Mr. K, a traveling magician, finds himself in a Kafkaesque nightmare when he can’t find the exit of the hotel, he has slept in. His attempts to get out only pull him deeper, entangling him further with the hotel and its curious inhabitants.

How well do you know the girl you love? When a teenager's body is found, her parents insist she's still alive. As another girl vanishes, Detective Jana Winter uncovers a web of friendship, longing and secrets where no one is who they seem.

p.t: The Cave Of The Yellow Dog
p.d: Nansal, a Mongolian nomadic girl finds a puppy and brings it home but her father believes it to be bad luck. But when the dog saves the family’s baby, he finally accepts it. Central to this tale is the belief in the cycle of rebirth between man and dog.

In this suspense thriller, Felix, an architect, lets a stranger into his home to use his phone. When the man suddenly disappears inside the house, Felix finds himself in in a cat and mouse chase and his house becomes a maze.

p.t: Helen Dorn: A Little Bit Of Freedom
p.d: Haunted by a missing boy's case from 14 years ago, Helen Dorn recently discovers a lead linking to the alleged perpetrator, Ron Faber. Dorn immediately heads for Hamburg when she learns that Faber was apprehended with a deceased Chinese boy in his van.

Princess Khutulun, a formidable Mongol warrior descended from Genghis Khan, has her marriage ambushed by an assassin who steals the Golden Sutra. Vowing revenge, Khutulun and her clan set out on an epic journey to retrieve the sacred text and restore peace.

Hui Buh is a blundering but lovable ghost desperately trying to hold onto his official, cherished "Haunting License". When a king takes over his castle to woo a countess, ghost and royalty end up in one harebrained scheme after another.

p.t: La La La at Rock Bottom
p.d: After his release from prison, Shigeo loses his memory in a brutal attack. Taken in by Kasumi, he becomes the lead singer of a band and lives a new life- until memories of his dark past begin to return.

They trusted her. Then, a series of mysterious deaths raised a chilling question: what, if anything, connected them? At the centre of the case is Sararat Rangsiwuthaporn, widely known as “Aem Cyanide”, whom police came to suspect in a number of deaths across Thailand. What began as an investigation into individual cases soon widened as police uncovered possible connections between them. Cyanide became a key focus, while questions emerged over money and the ‘sharing circle’ relationships which Aem had with some who died. With rare access to those closest to the case, the series goes inside an investigation that gripped Thailand and left families searching for answers. As new details come to light, it traces how suspicion fell on Aem and examines the evidence that turned a series of mysterious deaths into one of Thailand’s most extraordinary criminal investigations.

In this returning season of FINDING, six heartfelt reunions honour people who left a lasting mark. Nearly 40 years after Basic Military Training, Minister Ong Ye Kung searches for his BMT buddy Eric, while actor-host Noah Yap reunites with Ma’am Haiyan, the mentor who believed in him and supported his family through difficult times. Actor Elvin Ng and his mother travel to Indonesia to surprise Jumi, the domestic helper who became their pillar of strength, while 23-year-old Leticia journeys to Central Java to thank Auntie Mas, who helped raise her for 12 years. Dino Isaac reconnects with the Primary 3 teacher whose kindness gave him hope after a traumatic childhood, while radio DJ Gerald Koh and conservation educator John Chua surprise the teachers who inspired and guided them. Together, these emotional journeys celebrate friendship, gratitude and the lasting impact of those who quietly shape lives.

By Your Side follows families caring for loved ones with rare diseases, special needs, disabilities and the challenges of ageing. Parents of children with West syndrome and Harlequin ichthyosis navigate seizures, intensive treatments and daily care while celebrating every small achievement. Mothers of adult sons with ADHD, autism and intellectual disabilities devote years to helping them gain confidence, skills and independence. The series also follows families facing ALS and dementia, where spouses and children provide constant care as their loved ones gradually lose their independence. Across generations, these caregivers sacrifice careers, time and personal freedom, yet find strength in love and companionship. Their stories celebrate resilience, acceptance and the preciousness of simply being by someone's side.
